name: @mdxstudio/cli
description: Browse a whole folder of MDX and Markdown documents in the browser, with a navigable sidebar and live reload.
author: Suraj Donthi
//client: `dist/client/` is the browser half: React, the renderer and the plugin packages, bundled once at build time by scripts/build-client.mjs. It ships inside the tarball, so `npx @mdxstudio/cli serve` starts a server without installing or compiling anything in the folder being read.
//devDependencies: Everything the browser half is built from is a devDependency, not a dependency: it is bundled into dist/client at build time and no consumer resolves it. The CLI itself has no runtime dependencies at all, so `npx @mdxstudio/cli` is one small download.
